title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A clearly personal bag, personal cash, food or a camera-capable personal smartphone is present or used by an employee INSIDE the cashier cash-handling zone.
limitation: Medicines, medical devices and communication devices without photo/video capability are allowed. Customer items and normal banking equipment are not employee personal items. Do not guess device capabilities or ownership.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: Cash from an explicitly FINISHED earlier customer operation remains outside a locked cash storage device while another customer operation starts. Cash acceptance and counting must occur in the customer's presence.
limitation: Cash of the CURRENT customer may be on the work surface. Leaving a chair is not by itself proof of this paragraph being violated. The ownership and operation context must be visible.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A COMPLETE acceptance operation is visibly performed without counting incoming banknotes or coins or checking authenticity.
limitation: A cash-counting machine counts as counting. Sparse frames, hidden equipment and missing beginning/end cannot prove omission. Do not infer exact amounts or authenticity from appearance.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A COMPLETE incoming-cash operation visibly ends without the required cashier signature and stamp on cash documents.
limitation: Unreadable paper, off-camera actions, electronic documents and sparse sampled frames cannot prove missing signatures or stamps.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A COMPLETE incoming-cash operation visibly finishes without giving the customer a confirming document.
limitation: Electronic confirmation, off-camera handover and sparse frames mean absence cannot be established.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
section: Пункт 31, подпункт 4, с учётом пункта 32. Редакция от 16.03.2026
condition: A COMPLETE outgoing-cash operation visibly hands over LOOSE banknotes without counting in the customer's presence.
limitation: Paragraph 32 permits intact sealed banknote packs to be issued without recounting individual notes. Machines count as counting; sparse frames cannot prove omission.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A COMPLETE outgoing-cash operation visibly ends without the required cashier signature and stamp on cash documents.
limitation: Unreadable paper, off-camera actions, electronic documents and sparse sampled frames cannot prove missing signatures or stamps.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: A COMPLETE outgoing-cash operation visibly finishes without giving the customer a confirming document.
limitation: Electronic confirmation, off-camera handover and sparse frames mean absence cannot be established.

title: Правила осуществления кассовых операций и операций по инкассации, постановление НБРК от 29.11.2019 № 231
condition: The cashier visibly leaves the cash workstation before finishing the ongoing incoming-cash customer service, while the customer remains waiting.
limitation: Standing, reaching, turning, using nearby equipment, staff handover, or departure after completed service is not sufficient. The provision is in the incoming cash operations section.
